limitations: This is source approval only; supplied cluster status was not independently queried or certified in this review.
Same recipe, seed and corpus make this an engineering calibration, not an independent scientific seed, trained-quality result or completed full training.
Whole-device sampled memory is not an exact allocator peak. Concurrent shared storage, startup and cache effects limit isolated throughput comparisons.
The fixed time guard bounds the requested step, not completion: delayed step start, external cancellation or coordinator failure can interrupt it and leave an incomplete receipt.
Rough full-recipe projections must retain startup and evaluation/checkpoint/sequence-mix caveats.
